verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is downloadable at https://vercel.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so the core of the story is delivered. The spec is Vercel's platform-wide spec, and nothing in the pack shows it includes the Sandbox endpoints. missing for 10: evidence that the spec covers Sandbox API endpoints, first-party docs pointing to or describing the spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of its use.
